tours.title: Horseback Riding Tours
tours.subtitle: Discover the natural beauty of La Fortuna on horseback, guided through forest trails and river crossings by our experienced local team.

card.title: Nature Trail Horseback Tour
card.description: Live an authentic horseback adventure through tropical forest trails, crossing streams and discovering the breathtaking landscapes of La Fortuna alongside our skilled local guides.

gallery.title: Discover the Landscape
gallery.subtitle: Every ride through El Abanico is a unique encounter with the nature of La Fortuna — rivers, forest trails, open fields and breathtaking views await you.
gallery.slide1Desc: Wade through crystal-clear streams surrounded by lush tropical forest.
gallery.slide2Desc: Discover ancient paths winding through the heart of the jungle canopy.
gallery.slide3Desc: Meet our horses at Finca El Abanico, a working natural farm in La Fortuna.
gallery.slide4Desc: Perfect for all ages — our calm horses and experienced guides ensure a safe and fun ride.
gallery.slide5Desc: End your journey with golden light painting the sky over the rainforest valleys.
